payload.prompt: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Buchhaltungsdimension "Region" mit den Werten "Vestlandet" und "Midt-Norge". Buchen Sie dann einen Beleg auf Konto 6540 über 8600 NOK, verknüpft mit dem Dimensionswert "Vestlandet".

payload.goal: Create a custom accounting dimension "Region" with values "Vestlandet" and "Midt-Norge", then post a voucher on account 6540 for 8600 NOK linked to dimension value "Vestlandet".
success_checks: Voucher is created with a line on account 6540 for 8600 NOK.
Voucher line is linked to dimension value "Vestlandet".
Voucher is balanced and posted in an open accounting period.
risk_notes: Custom dimensions may require a specific module/feature to be enabled before creation.
Voucher posting requires balancing lines; counter-account is not specified.
Voucher date is not provided; API may require an explicit posting date in an open period.
VAT handling is not specified; for a general ledger voucher on account 6540, VAT treatment may need clarification depending on company settings.
Currency is stated as NOK, but voucher endpoint may assume company base currency rather than explicit currency field.

line_items.description: Voucher line on account 6540 linked to dimension value Vestlandet

ordered_steps: Check whether custom accounting dimensions feature/module is enabled; enable it if not.
Create custom dimension named "Region" via custom dimensions endpoint.
Determine a valid voucher date in an open accounting period.
Prepare a balanced voucher with one debit or credit line on account 6540 for 8600 NOK and a counter-line on an appropriate balancing account.
Attach dimension mapping so the 6540 line references dimension "Region" value "Vestlandet".
Post the voucher via voucher endpoint.
Verify voucher posting succeeded and dimension linkage is present on the 6540 line.

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.text:
Let me analyze the task:

1. Create a custom accounting dimension "Region" with values "Vestlandet" and "Midt-Norge"
2. Post a voucher on account 6540 for 8600 NOK linked to dimension value "Vestlandet"

Following the trace template:
1. GET /ledger/account?number=6540 - Resolve expense account
2. GET /ledger/account?number=1920 - Resolve counter-account (bank)
3. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionName - Create "Region" dimension
4. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionValue - Create "Vestlandet"


5. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionValue - Create "Midt-Norge"
6. POST /ledger/voucher - Create the voucher with postings

I need to think through the dependencies here. The dimension values require the dimensionIndex from the dimension creation, and the voucher needs both accounts resolved plus the dimension value ID. So I'll start by running the account lookups and dimension name creation in parallel, then create the dimension values once I have the dimension index, and finally post the voucher once everything is ready.

For the voucher itself, since no VAT rate is specified, I'll set vatType to 0 for exempt and manually include both the debit posting to account 6540 for 8600 NOK and the credit posting to account 1920 for -8600 NOK. I'll attach the Vestlandet dimension value to the 6540 posting through freeAccountingDimension1.

I'll analyze the task: create custom dimension "Region" with two values, then post a voucher on account 6540 for 8600 NOK linked to "Vestlandet".

Let me start with parallel calls: resolve both accounts and create the dimension.
